title: MADLAD-400: A Multilingual And Document-Level Large Audited Dataset
findings: During the self-audit of the web-crawled data, it was found that a significant fraction of the corpora for many languages, particularly low-resource ones, contained mostly or entirely religious documents. Specifically, 141 languages had significant amounts of Bible data, 37 had Jehovah's Witnesses (JW) data, and 2 had Latter-day Saints (LDS) data. Additionally, it was noted that standard toxicity filters incorrectly flagged non-toxic religious terms from the Qur'an (e.g., 'kafir', 'mercy', 'purity') as toxic, highlighting issues with applying generic filters to religious contexts.
